commands.name: Amplify
commands.tip: Increases or decreases the volume of the audio you have selected

commands.name: Auto Duck
commands.tip: Reduces (ducks) the volume of one or more tracks whenever the volume of a specified "control" track reaches a particular level

commands.name: Bass and Treble
commands.tip: Simple tone control effect

commands.name: Change Pitch
commands.tip: Changes the pitch of a track without changing its tempo

commands.name: Change Speed
commands.tip: Changes the speed of a track, also changing its pitch

commands.name: Change Tempo
commands.tip: Changes the tempo of a selection without changing its pitch

commands.name: Chirp
commands.tip: Generates an ascending or descending tone of one of four types

commands.name: Click Removal
commands.tip: Click Removal is designed to remove clicks on audio tracks

commands.name: Compressor
commands.tip: Compresses the dynamic range of audio

commands.name: DTMF Tones
commands.tip: Generates dual-tone multi-frequency (DTMF) tones like those produced by the keypad on telephones

commands.name: Distortion
commands.tip: Waveshaping distortion effect

commands.name: Echo
commands.tip: Repeats the selected audio again and again

commands.name: Fade In
commands.tip: Applies a linear fade-in to the selected audio

commands.name: Fade Out
commands.tip: Applies a linear fade-out to the selected audio

commands.name: Filter Curve EQ
commands.tip: Adjusts the volume levels of particular frequencies

commands.name: Find Clipping
commands.tip: Creates labels where clipping is detected

commands.name: Graphic EQ
commands.tip: Adjusts the volume levels of particular frequencies

commands.name: Invert
commands.tip: Flips the audio samples upside-down, reversing their polarity

commands.name: Loudness Normalization
commands.tip: Sets the loudness of one or more tracks

commands.name: Noise Reduction
commands.tip: Removes background noise such as fans, tape noise, or hums

commands.name: Noise
commands.tip: Generates one of three different types of noise

commands.name: Normalize
commands.tip: Sets the peak amplitude of one or more tracks

commands.name: Paulstretch
commands.tip: Paulstretch is only for an extreme time-stretch or "stasis" effect

commands.name: Phaser
commands.tip: Combines phase-shifted signals with the original signal

commands.name: Repair
commands.tip: Sets the peak amplitude of a one or more tracks

commands.name: Repeat
commands.tip: Repeats the selection the specified number of times

commands.name: Reverb
commands.tip: Adds ambience or a "hall effect"

commands.name: Reverse
commands.tip: Reverses the selected audio

commands.name: Silence
commands.tip: Creates audio of zero amplitude

commands.name: Stereo To Mono
commands.tip: Converts stereo tracks to mono

commands.name: Tone
commands.tip: Generates a constant frequency tone of one of four types

commands.name: Truncate Silence
commands.tip: Automatically reduces the length of passages where the volume is below a specified level

commands.name: Wahwah
commands.tip: Rapid tone quality variations, like that guitar sound so popular in the 1970's
